summary: Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole tone has kept a September Fed rate hike in play, leaving Friday's August jobs report as the week's decisive data point. Elevated energy costs are simultaneously driving global inflation higher, pressuring bonds and weighing on equities.
tweet: Warsh talked hawkish at Jackson Hole and Friday's jobs report now decides whether a September Fed hike happens — energy-driven inflation is squeezing the rest.
